objective: Allow an interrupted multi-input three-look batch to resume from fully validated per-job checkpoints and publish one final create-only directory without rerendering valid completed jobs.

workspace.exclusive_lease: sibling lock file held by a nonblocking Windows process-lifetime byte-range lock

checkpoint.unit: one input job containing exactly three RGB16 PNG outputs, three strict recipes and one child manifest
checkpoint.completed_child_publication: reserved sibling transient, full validation, then Windows os.rename to the absent canonical job directory
checkpoint.checkpoint_ledger_update: atomic and strictly after canonical child publication
checkpoint.maximum_new_jobs_per_invocation: optional integer 1..100; omission completes all remaining jobs

formal_fixture.generator: the unchanged deterministic U7.8A 32x24 RGB8 PNG generator
formal_fixture.comparison: one uninterrupted execution with the same committed source, inputs, destination binding and parameters

stop_rules: Do not modify U7.8A, U7.8C, the single-input renderer, stock parameters, default renderer, recipe schemas or product claims.
Do not accept a checkpoint from a different manifest, destination binding, software commit, profile, statistics, guardrails or render parameters.
Do not silently delete, replace or rerender a malformed completed checkpoint.
Do not trust checkpoint counts or status without independently rehashing the inputs, configuration, core identity and every completed artifact.
Do not weaken full-file hashing, strict recipe validation, exclusive workspace lease, create-only publication or Windows-only atomicity.

Do not claim hard-power-loss durability during a currently executing child render, 24MP throughput, installer readiness, calibrated stock response, stock distinguishability, public release or product value.
Any formal gate failure closes this exact resumable workspace without threshold, checkpoint, cohort, order or retry rescue.
claim_ceiling: Private Windows/Python resumable batch mechanics for the three existing deterministic film-inspired Look Approximations; no calibrated or physical stock response, 24MP performance, installer, public API, package, release or product-value claim.
